offering_description.value: The company builds, repairs, and maintains transportation infrastructure and prepares sites for government agencies, developers, and commercial property owners. Local crews deliver projects using a network of asphalt plants, aggregate facilities, and liquid asphalt terminals, and the company also supplies hot-mix asphalt and aggregates to outside customers.

quotes.quote: Construction Partners builds and maintains transportation infrastructure in regions with consistent, long-term demand for investment. Partnering with state and federal agencies, municipalities, school districts, and military installations, we deliver essential public projects that support growth and provide stability through changing economic conditions. Our work with private developers and commercial property owners expands that foundation, adding balance and opportunity across some of the nation’s fastest-growing markets.

Our vertically integrated network gives us control over the materials that define quality and performance. From aggregate facilities and liquid asphalt terminals to hot-mix asphalt plants, we manage each step of production to ensure consistency, reliability, and precision in every project. This integration strengthens schedules, stabilizes costs, and supports our teams in delivering durable, high-performing pavement across every market we serve.

We supply materials for paving projects and external customers through a network of hot-mix asphalt plants. Controlling production allows us to manage costs, maintain quality, and deliver reliable schedules across every market we serve.

We produce and supply aggregates that form the foundation of every construction project. Operating our own facilities secures material availability, improves efficiency, and adds value through external sales.

primary_services.value: Infrastructure construction and paving; pavement milling and resurfacing; pavement repair and maintenance; site preparation

quotes.quote: Local crews pave, mill, and maintain roads, runways, and sites—safely and reliably.

We partner with private developers and business owners to prepare sites for retail centers, industrial parks, and residential communities. These projects support local growth, create opportunity, and strengthen regional economies.
